bestBets.overview: A competitive Moree card for this Thursday and we will have a Good track rating on offer. We open with a few handy Maidens. Here in the first, HIGHLAND DANCER scratches after competing at Quirindi on Tuesday. Newcomer STOP THE METER has had only one trial and that was on Monday just gone at Newcastle. He was a nice steady 2L 4th/8 in that 800m heat. Whether they want to back him up here we will wait and see. HANEY made a nice return for his new stable, finishing 2nd to an odds-on winner that was then good at Wyong over last weekend. Can lead the way here as well. ASTRA VIA hit the front a fair way from home at Muswellbrook and perhaps could take a cute little trail here. Nick Palmer can't claim below the given weight of 55 kilos though.

bestBets.overview: SIDE QUEST claims down to 54 and can probably find the front here. It seems only a matter of time before she can break through and she has found something suitable here for sure. An apprentice takes the ride on FLAUNTER for the first time but she won't claim below 55 so her claim is not really a factor. Has been in the mix in all appearances though so we'll giver her due regard to go close again. Presume she crosses outside the above-mentioned leader?
